body: Create a TRUE LOW-RES PIXEL ART atlas matching reference1, the actual in-game mage sprite. Reference2 supplies the exact 8-column 5-row animation layout and body scale. NOT smooth chibi illustration, NOT painted high-res anime shrunk down. Draw in a strict 64x64 logical pixel grid per frame, character approximately 44 pixels high, feet baseline pixel56. HEAD WITHOUT HAIR approximately 13 pixels high, body and legs together at least24 pixels; no oversized chibi head. Hard pixel clusters, crisp single-pixel contour, 24-color palette, flat 2-tone shading, no antialiasing, no gradients or sheen. Same small JRPG sprite aesthetic as the mage reference. Female warrior with brown ponytail (compact, no huge flowing hair), amber eyes, navy and ivory crossed tunic, small gold trim, white waist sash, short navy overskirt over dark leggings, brown boots. Fully clothed. NO weapon because weapon is separate. EXACTLY 40 individual sprites: 8 columns x5 rows. Idle idle walk0 walk1 walk2 walk3 attack-ready hurt. Rows front; three-quarter front facing LEFT; side facing RIGHT; three-quarter back RIGHT; full back. Consistent design and scale. Each 64px logical cell has empty transparent margins, nothing overlapping. Display atlas at an integer pixel enlargement while retaining visible square pixel clusters, true transparent background. Reproduce the reference mage's restrained pixel rendering, visual weight and body proportions, not its hat or silver hair. No text, no labels, no shadows.
attack: Matching pixel-art ATTACK animation atlas for reference1 female swordswoman. Copy her exact small pixel sprite design: brown ponytail, navy/ivory/gold tunic, white sash, dark leggings, brown boots. Reference2 specifies attack motion. EXACT SIX COLUMNS by FIVE ROWS (30 isolated full-body sprites) with wide transparent gutters, no labels. Same restrained 24-color palette, square hard-edged pixel clusters, NO gradients, NO smooth chibi rendering, NO enlarged head. Logical figure 44 pixels tall on a 64px canvas, head about13 pixels tall plus hair, clear torso and legs. Rows: front, front three-quarter facing screen LEFT, profile RIGHT, rear three-quarter facing screen RIGHT, full BACK. Columns wind-up weapon hand raised; prepare; swing; contact hand extended; follow-through; recovery. Clearly visible small right hand and articulated bracing legs. Do not draw sword; it is a separate game sprite. Keep every pose centered on same baseline and same consistent adult female design, fully clothed nonsexual. True transparent alpha background. Render the logical pixel atlas at integer enlargement, crisp native pixel appearance. No scenery, effects, floating fragments or shadows.
